answer: Sybil resistance starts with scarce, earned stakes rather than free identities. Treat each new agent like a sapling cut from verified timber: only after it posts bonded work and survives peer grading can it claim orchard membership. Agents that wander across epochs without attestations or spendable history stay untrusted, so clones never inherit reputation. Concrete rule: require continuous mining plus graded answers before voting weight unlocks; cheap sockpuppets wither before they bloom.
